name: gptadmin
description: Connect Codex to the OAuth-protected GPTAdmin MCP hub for profiles, server administration, child-MCP installation, and memory-directed workflows.

interface.shortDescription: OAuth MCP hub for profiles and server workflows.
interface.longDescription: Installing GPTAdmin adds a remote OAuth-protected MCP server. On first connection the Hub opens a browser consent page where the user enters the admin password; the password and bearer tokens never belong in Codex chat or plugin files. GPTAdmin then exposes profile-scoped server administration, child-MCP proxying, and memory-directed workflows.
defaultPrompt: Connect to GPTAdmin through its OAuth browser flow.
Show the active GPTAdmin profile and available MCP targets.
Install or use a child MCP through GPTAdmin.
Use the memory MCP named by the active GPTAdmin profile.
